name: Digital twin builder (Microsoft Fabric)
short_description: A preview item in Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence for modeling real-world assets and their relationships as an ontology on a low-code semantic canvas, with twin data stored in OneLake.

evidence.quote: is Fabric's Digital Twin Builder the answer to our messy data or just another data swamp
Fabric's digital twin builder puts its cards on the table with the semantic canvas
